problem_statement: Build a brand-new /changelog page from scratch on the Astroplate site (Astro 6 + Tailwind). The /changelog route does not exist yet (baseline 404/empty). Construct the whole page reusing the site's shared chrome (Base.astro layout with its Header nav and Footer) and design tokens, so it looks like a native part of the site. The page presents a data-driven, reverse-chronological list of release entries built from an inline static dataset (version, date, type, title, body). Add a page intro paragraph and a live count heading. Provide a client-side filter with three controls (All / Features / Fixes) keyed on a unique data-cl-filter attribute: clicking a filter shows only the matching release cards and updates the count heading (e.g. 'Showing 2 updates' when Fixes is selected). The page must render with no horizontal overflow at 390px mobile and reuse the shared Header/Footer navigation identically to sibling pages such as /about.
required_content: A /changelog route rendered inside the shared Base.astro layout (shared Header nav + Footer chrome, not a one-off shell)
An intro paragraph starting 'Every release, fix, and improvement...'
An h1/h3 live count heading reading 'Showing 5 updates' by default
Three filter buttons labelled All, Features, Fixes, each with a unique data-cl-filter attribute (all/feature/fix)
A reverse-chronological list of 5 release cards built from an inline static array, each with a version (v2.4.0...), date, title (h3/h4) and body, and a data-cl-type attribute (feature/fix)
Client-side interaction: clicking Fixes shows only the 2 fix cards and updates the count to 'Showing 2 updates'; clicking All restores all 5
Mobile (390px) renders with zero horizontal overflow
Shared Header nav links (About, Blog) and Footer links (Privacy Policy) render identically to sibling pages
Version badges use the exact prefix 'v' + semver, newest first: v2.4.0, then earlier v2.x/v2.3.x entries
Each release card exposes a data-cl-type attribute equal to 'feature' or 'fix' matching its type
design_constraints: Reuse Base.astro layout + Header/Footer partials (no bespoke chrome)
Reuse site utility classes: section-sm, container, row, lg:col-*, btn/btn-sm/btn-primary/btn-outline-primary, border-border, bg-light, font-secondary, text-primary
Reuse theme tokens (Heebo/Signika fonts, primary color, light/dark surfaces) — no new palette
Inline static release data — no network/CMS fetch

Palette (no new colors): page surface stays near-white (#ffffff / #f6f6f6 light surfaces); primary action color is the dark brand token rgb(18,18,18) (#121212) used by btn-primary; body text rgb(68,68,68)/rgb(4,4,4); border rgb(234,234,234)
Fonts: headings Signika, body Heebo (theme font-secondary/primary tokens) — no new fonts
Active filter uses btn-primary (dark #121212 fill); inactive filters use btn-outline-primary
